scripts.test: npx cucumber-js --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format json:allure-results/cucumber-report.json
scripts.test:ui: npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format json:allure-results/ui-report.json
scripts.test:api: npx cucumber-js tests/features/APIFeature --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format json:allure-results/api-report.json
scripts.test:performance: npx cucumber-js tests/features/performance --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format json:allure-results/performance-report.json
scripts.test:login: npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature/login.feature --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress
scripts.test:cucumber: npx cucumber-js --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format json:allure-results/cucumber-report.json --format html:reports/cucumber-report.html
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:ui && npm run test:api && npm run test:performance
scripts.report:report: start allure-report/index.html || open allure-report/index.html || xdg-open allure-report/index.html
scripts.report:generate: npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report 2>/dev/null || echo 'Java not found - using pre-generated report'
scripts.debug: npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature/login.feature --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --dry-run
